name: Adf Foods Ltd
title: Adf Foods Ltd-$ - 519183 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 consolidated revenue INR196.7 cr (+23.7%) and standalone EBITDA margin 24.3%, but utilisation of 70-75% and a Surat greenfield ramping, with GCC (under 15% of revenue) shut since March; FY27 guide of INR925-1,000 cr now conditional on Middle East reopening.

utilisation.quote: at an average, I would say we were anywhere between 70% to 75% capacity utilization.

capex.quote: There will be some bit of capex still as Bimal was saying, the new line for pizza base will be coming up.

triggers.label: Surat greenfield commenced March 2026
triggers.quote: Phase 1 of the Surat greenfield facility commenced its commercial production in March 2026.

triggers.label: GCC shipments halted; 80-85% impact
triggers.quote: the GCC business has been impacted by at least about 80%, 85% for us.

triggers.label: Worst case FY27 growth 12-15%
triggers.quote: over our financial year '26, we would look at growth of about 12% to 15% overall.

triggers.label: Core utilisation 70-75%
triggers.quote: at an average, I would say we were anywhere between 70% to 75% capacity utilization.

guidance.quote: we feel fairly confident of being able to achieve it provided the geopolitical situations improve.
we expect the Ashoka brand to grow close to 30%, 35% in this fiscal year.
we expect in terms of revenue around INR40 crores to INR50 crores contribution from the Surat facility in this fiscal year.
we feel fairly confident that we will maintain these high -teen EBITDAs, which we've been giving guidance for.

red_flags.label: Middle East shipments zero in March-April
red_flags.quote: March and April have seen a very insignificant sale out there.

red_flags.label: Growth ex-GCC only 12-15% in worst case
red_flags.quote: If the Middle East remains at 0 level, right.

red_flags.label: PLI incentive ends after FY27
red_flags.quote: this financial year '27 is -- yes, this year will be the last year.

evasions.topic: Middle East revenue Jan-Feb and quantum of freight cost
evasions.quote: I don't know the exact number. But as I mentioned, the GCC accounts overall for about under 15% of our revenues.
No, we don't normally share detailed information.
